question: Gopal invests a sum of ₹5400 and Akshay invests a sum of ₹9400 at the same rate of simple interest per annum. If, at the end of 6 years, Akshay gets ₹720 more interest than Gopal, then find the rate of interest per annum (in percentage).
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Difference in investment = ₹9400 − ₹5400 = ₹4000.

Extra simple interest for 6 years = ₹720.

Extra interest for 1 year = 720 ÷ 6 = ₹120.

Rate % = (Interest for 1 year ÷ Extra Principal) × 100

Rate % = (120 ÷ 4000) × 100 = 3%.

**∴ The correct answer is 3%.**
